import "experimental"
from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /lsst.sal.ESS.agcGenset150/)
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.salIndex == 305 or r.salIndex == 306)  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    salIndex: r.salIndex,
    generatorModel: if r.salIndex == 306 then "Caterpillar" else "Mitsubishi",    running: if r.running == true then "Running" else "Stopped",
    mode: if r.blockMode then "BLOCK" else if r.testMode then "TEST" else if r.manualMode then "MANUAL" else if r.semiAutoMode then "SEMI-AUTO" else if r.autoMode then "AUTO" else "DESCONOCIDO"
  }))
  |> sort(columns: ["salIndex"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "salIndex", "generatorModel", "running", "mode"])
